description: Vital Signs: Highway Pavement Condition – by segment is a dataset listed in Metropolitan Transportation Commission open data portal (data.bayareametro.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Metropolitan Transportation Commission. VITAL SIGNS INDICATOR Highway Pavement Condition (T17) FULL MEASURE NAME Distressed share of highway lane-miles LAST UPDATED February 2017 DESCRIPTION Highway pavement condition, measured by the share of highway lane-miles flagged as “distressed” by Caltrans, reflects the regional pavement quality on the highway system. The dataset includes regional and road segment tables. Coverage: San Francisco Bay Area. Its tags are vital signs. The table has 20 columns. Attribution on the portal: California Department of Transportation. The portal shows 2019-09-13 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-bayareametro-gov-portal.
